text: Loads the specified labware with the given labels/slots; suitable pipettes and tip racks.
40 uL beads (0.8x) to each of the 96 samples, mixed ~10 times, 5 min incubation recorded before the magnet.
Magnet engaged/settle recorded, then ~90 uL supernatant removed to waste from every well without disturbing beads.
Two 200 uL 80% ethanol washes, each fully removed to waste.
~5 min air dry, magnet disengaged, 50 uL water added and mixed ~10 times, 2 min incubation then magnet re-engaged.
45 uL eluate moved from each sample well to the matching elution plate well (sample identity preserved).
Fresh tip whenever touching a different sample (supernatant, ethanol removal, elution); no cross-contamination; reagent tips reused only sensibly.
Physically sensible: volumes within pipette limits, sensible aspiration heights near beads, operator pauses/comments where needed.
No invented, missing or reordered steps relative to the task text; comments and metadata accurate.
